name: Restrict Website Access
author: Zohaib Ali

sections.description:
Restrict Website Access is a powerful and easy-to-use WordPress plugin that allows you to protect your website with a password-based access control system. Whether you’re working on a private project, developing a new website, or simply want to restrict public access to your site.

With Restrict Website Access, you can easily set up a password protection system that restricts access to your entire site, ensuring only authorized users can access your content. This is perfect for developers, business owners, or anyone who needs to keep their site hidden while it’s under construction or during private phases of a project.

Key features include:

  • Password protection for your entire website
  • Simple setup with no coding required
  • Ideal for private or under-development websites
  • Easy-to-use interface with straightforward options

This plugin ensures that your site stays secure while you’re working on it or if you want to limit public access for any reason. Protect your WordPress site effortlessly with Restrict Website Access.

Source Code

The unminified versions of custom JavaScript and CSS files created for this plugin are included in the plugin package under the includes/admin and includes/public/ directory.

For third-party libraries used in this plugin, please refer to their official repositories:

  1. Notyf:
    • Source: https://github.com/caroso1222/notyf
    • License: MIT License
    • Location: includes/admin/library/notyf/
    • CDN (CSS): – https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/notyf@3/notyf.min.css.
    • CDN (JS): – https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/notyf@3/notyf.min.js
sections.installation:
From Your WordPress Dashboard

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New
  2. Search for Restrict Website Access
  3. Click on Install Now Button
  4. Click on Activate Now Button to use the plugin on your site.

From WordPress.org

  1. Download Restrict Website Access from the WordPress Plugin Directory.
  2. Upload the restrict-website-access folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  3. Activate Restrict Website Access plugin from your Plugins page.
